messages:
alex: quick heads-up — putting v2.14.0-candidate on canary at 10:30 PT. will do 10m -> 1h -> full if green. tagging folks.
priya: thanks. cutoff for changelog edits is 09:45 PT, any last minute notes?
sasha: i pushed changelog for model selector change. small wording tweak: 'selector rollback' -> 'fallback selector'.
ryan: noted. also need version bump for SDK: i can open a PR after canary passes, but want the version prefix to be v2.14.0-rc1 not -candidate. prefer stable naming.
alex: good point. plan: deploy as 'v2.14.0-canary' to infra, but release artifact will be 'v2.14.0-rc1' after we tag. ok?
priya: ok by me. quick reminder — if canary error rate >1% within 15m we roll back and notify #announcements with slip notice.
sasha: what's rollback procedure? last time was manual pod scale-down.
alex: rollback play: (1) switch router traffic to v2.13 fallback, (2) enact autoscale to drain canary nodes, (3) open issue with logs. I'll post commands.
alex: ```
# rollback to fallback
redwood route update default --version v2.13.5 --force
kubectl scale deployment rdw-canary -n inference --replicas=0
``` 
deploy-bot: canary deploy started at 2026-03-17T17:30:00Z
priya: tagging @eng-sre so they can watch metrics. @sre oncall can you take lead if error spike?
ryan: FYI i'll also pre-bump SDK in a draft PR: draft PR #482
sasha: if we do rollback, does someone want to craft the announcement? I can draft a short slip notice template: 'We are delaying release due to canary regression. ETA +2h — working on fix.'
alex: thanks. if we need it, sasha please post to #announcements and cc product and support. If all green at 11:40 PT we proceed to full rollout.
priya: ack. I'll run the final changelog CI at 09:50 PT and ping this thread.
alex: perfect. I'll follow up with final status. :thumbsup:
